title: 2.5.20 What Happens After a throw?
description: Build a try block where a throw sits between two other lines, and confirm exactly which lines run. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed — practice for 2.5.4 Concepts in Practice 'Throwing'

steps.title: Predict first
steps.instructions: In a comment, predict what prints from this sequence: log "start", throw new Error("stop right here"), log "after the throw", catch logs "caught: " + err.message.

steps.title: Build it
steps.instructions: Write a try block that logs "start", then throws new Error("stop right here"), then logs "after the throw". In the catch block, log "caught: " + err.message.

steps.title: Confirm and explain
steps.instructions: Run it. In a comment, explain why "after the throw" never prints — what does throw abandon, exactly like a runtime error?

requirements.description: Throws new Error with the message stop right here
